allocation.conditional_followup: Any strong-parent continuation requires a separate extension; current --init validation rejects this auxiliary screen.

common_recipe.architecture: plain GRU, H512 x 1, linear encoder, one-layer readout
common_recipe.input_control: 367-slot i1_history representation; --research-feature-control all zeroes all history slots; --drop-i1 remains false
common_recipe.objective: unchanged weighted MSE plus dynamics_aux_weight times mean Huber loss (delta=1)
common_recipe.precision: strict FP32, autocast off, TF32 off
common_recipe.checkpoint_policy: fixed checkpoint epoch 2; no in-fit evaluation
common_recipe.optimizer: AdamW, OneCycle, lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.01, beta2=0.999, clip=1
common_recipe.normalization: existing fitting-only input normalization; target statistics fit on exact unique selected fit sequences
common_recipe.seed_pairing: control and dynamics arms share the same seed within each fold; both allocate the auxiliary head so base weights and head initialization match
common_recipe.future_input_policy: future observations are labels only; full raw sequences are read before TBPTT slicing and never added to model inputs

outputs_per_group_horizon: log mean squared standardized one-step change
targets.validity: t >= existing warmup-valid boundary and t+h < complete sequence length
targets.target_standardization: per output, fitting-membership mean and population standard deviation floored at 1e-3

f2.integration_rule: Integrate this frozen artifact by exact hash before running; do not regenerate.

commands.fit_template: uv run python -u scripts/train_rnn.py --name RUN --device cuda --arch gru --hidden 512 --layers 1 --head-layers 1 --dropout 0 --batch 8 --chunk 2000 --epochs 3 --checkpoint-policy fixed --checkpoint-epoch 2 --no-eval-during-fit --save-training-state --loss wmse --loss-norm chunk --optim adamw --sched onecycle --warmup-frac 0.05 --lr 0.001 --wd 0.01 --beta2 0.999 --clip 1 --precision fp32 --grad-stats --deterministic --seed SEED --batch-order seeded --train-source train+valid --train-seqs 10607 --valid-repeat 1 --research-features i1_history --research-feature-control all --split-manifest SPLIT --fit-subset-manifest FIT_SUBSET --fit-subset-experiment-id SUBSET_ID --dynamics-aux-head --dynamics-aux-weight WEIGHT
commands.prediction_template: uv run python -u scripts/predict_run.py RUN valid --campaign-split-manifest SPLIT --campaign-evaluation-only --device cuda --output-name RUN --epoch 2
commands.score_template: uv run python -u scripts/score_run.py --run RUN --split SPLIT --epoch 2 --prediction cache/pred_RUN_valid.npy
commands.fixed_mixture: 0.9 control + 0.1 dynamics candidate within each matched fold/seed cell; no coefficient search

uv run ruff check <changed Python files>
